overview_description.description: smol machines develops infrastructure tools that let developers build, run, and distribute portable Linux micro-virtual machines. Its Rust-based smolvm command-line tool uses libkrun to create hardware-isolated environments with their own kernel and sub-second boot times on macOS and Linux. Developers can run ephemeral or persistent virtual machines, execute container images, mount host directories, and configure resources such as CPU, memory, networking, and GPU access. smol machines defines a .smolmachine artifact format that packages a complete stateful virtual environment into a single file for reproducible execution across compatible hosts. The company also offers SDKs for TypeScript and Python that expose APIs for machine lifecycle management, command execution, and container operations. These tools are used for sandboxing untrusted code, reproducible development environments, GPU-accelerated workloads, and automated analysis pipelines.
